stats.notes: From VSU's Fall 2024 Common Data Set (C1, C9, C11). CDS counts differ slightly from IPEDS (6,267 vs 6,253 applicants). Residency split: in-state 4,320, out-of-state 1,813, international 87, unknown 47 applicants; international admits 41 (47% of international applicants vs 72% overall) and 9 enrolled. GPA bands are the 'all enrolled students' column; 0.1% had a GPA below 1.0. A 2025-2026 CDS PDF is posted but its filled-in values did not extract as text, so the 2024-2025 edition was used. Undergraduate enrollment and student-faculty ratio are IPEDS fall 2024. The CDS marks one importance box per factor with no readable column, so 'factors' is omitted.

cds_test_policy.notes: VSU admissions page: applicants with an academic GPA of 3.2 or higher can be admitted without ACT/SAT; those with 3.1 or lower should submit official scores.
